2e9739eb200b1720.description: About the Role Ninja is looking for skilled Maintenance Technicians to perform preventive and reactive maintenance across our stores and facilities. The ideal candidate will have practical experience in electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration, ensuring equipment reliability and smooth store operations. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and repair electrical, HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, and basic building defects. Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, inspections, cleaning, and equipment checks. Respond to urgent breakdowns and maintenance requests as scheduled. Update maintenance work orders with findings, parts used, photos, and completion details. Follow safety procedures and use approved tools and personal protective equipment (PPE). Coordinate maintenance activities with store teams and report recurring issues or warranty-related defects. Escalate complex repairs requiring specialist support or external service providers. Technical diploma or trade certificate. 3–5 years of practical maintenance experience. Working knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration. Ability to perform preventive and corrective maintenance. Familiarity with mobile work orders or maintenance management systems. Strong troubleshooting skills and commitment to workplace safety

2e476c6ff7a69df6.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects is part of alfanar, a Riyadh-headquartered company operating construction and manufacturing businesses, design and development centers, and various facilities across the Middle East and other countries. Alfanar is involved in electrical, electromechanical, and civil engineering construction, manufacturing and marketing electrical construction products, and allied engineering services. Alfanar Construction is classified as a Grade I contractor by the Government of Saudi Arabia and specializes in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) across energy, infrastructure, and engineering services sectors. Core EPC activities include Power and Water Projects, Transmission and Distribution Projects, Building Construction (Industrial & Commercial), and Electro-Mechanical projects. Job Summary Alfanar Projects is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join its team in Jeddah, Western Region. This full-time position is responsible for planning, organizing, and controlling the electrical activities of projects to ensure successful completion within established guidelines, schedules, budgets, and Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) policy constraints, as defined by the Project Manager. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Review project electrical documents, including methodology, quality assurance, control procedures, engineering, and construction time schedules. Prepare and review technical submittals such as designs, specifications, drawings, calculations, method statements, TPIs, and risk assessments for compliance with client, authority, end-user requirements, and local/international standards. Oversee and inspect site installation work daily, witness tests, identify non-compliance with construction documentation, and recommend corrective measures. Coordinate daily with the Team Leader and other team members to verify, document, and report quality issues of work performed by subcontractors, and suggest corrective actions. Ensure all construction activities proceed efficiently at the site and review progress. Conduct technical meetings and maintain constant follow-up with Client Design and Engineering Divisions. Maintain the quality standards of all electrical activities as per the project quality plan. Role Accountabilities Train subordinates and build a team to ensure effective work execution. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates in all aspects of their work. Delegate assignments to subordinates. Ensure fair distribution of tasks to maintain morale and motivation among subordinates. Execute planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve any related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Western Region.

2e978e4ba3c7a4f1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الزلفي، الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها. كما يتضمن تقييم تطور الحالات المرضية وفاعلية العلاج، وإعداد التقارير الطبية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، ودراسة الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي بدوام كامل في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان بمدينة الزلفي، الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق طبي متخصص والمساهمة في تقديم خدمات رعاية صحية متميزة. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2ede679340b5a651.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Industries Company is seeking a Planning Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on demand operations and supply chain policy adherence, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. The specialist will be responsible for developing and refining demand forecasts, optimizing supply methods, and ensuring efficient inventory management. Key Responsibilities in Demand Operations Develop demand forecasts at multiple levels of aggregation for various time horizons. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate forecast results. Conduct cross-functional research activities to reconcile significant variances and refine the forecast model to reflect updated sales and marketing assumptions. Utilize a collaboration and consensus approach by working with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts. Assist in developing new or optimizing existing methods of supply, including emergency strategies, using corporate standard concepts. Perform quantitative and qualitative evaluations, considering the impact on logistics costs and structure. Investigate supply methods such as transportation, packaging, source of supply, and material flow for new or existing suppliers, as well as new supplier selection processes. Initiate, investigate, and develop medium to long-term planning strategies influencing supplier selection, and implement process improvements through innovation. Monitor warehouse inventory and communicate slow and non-moving inventory to relevant parties for immediate action. Prepare reports and statistics related to demand planning and forecasting. Use and maintain the Demand Planning Software as the primary forecasting system tool. Policy and Process Adherence Follow all relevant Supply Chain policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices, considering leading practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity improvement. Promote the implementation and adherence to policies, processes, and operating procedures within Alkhorayef Industries Company (AIC). Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant planning or supply chain role. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage demand forecasts. Experience with demand planning software and statistical forecasting models. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within Alkhorayef Industries Company. The role involves cross-functional collaboration with various departments including Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

2e33e176dbd2cadf.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، راس تنورة، بقيق، حفر الباطن، والخفجي. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم أعلى مستويات الخدمة والاحترافية للعملاء في عرض وبيع المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة طلباتهم المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عرض وبيع المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. استقبال ومتابعة طلبات بيع المنتجات، وإدخالها وتنفيذها على النظام. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة لهم. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح، وتعريفهم بكيفية استخدام مكائن الصرف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص عند الضرورة. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفق الإجراءات، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها بالنظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات للعملاء. استلام طلبات قفل الحساب وتعديل بياناته وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. استقبال العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع، وإدخاله بالنظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في النظام المخصص. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن المخالفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والتعامل باحترافية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. بيئة العمل يعمل استشاري المبيعات بدوام كامل في فروع مصرف الراجحي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة مصرفية ديناميكية تركز على خدمة العملاء وتحقيق الأهداف. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور متاح في عدة مدن بالمنطقة الشرقية، بما في ذلك الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، راس تنورة، بقيق، حفر الباطن، والخفجي.

2e8756f93bb5ee74.company_name: شركة نقل المياه Water Transmission Company
2e8756f93bb5ee74.description: About the Water Transmission Company The Water Transmission Company (شركة نقل المياه) is seeking a Data Management Office Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on developing, implementing, and governing the company's data management strategy. Role Purpose The Data Management Office Specialist is responsible for establishing and maintaining WTCO's data management framework. This role ensures compliance with national and international data standards, protects sensitive information, supports open data initiatives, and enhances the organization's data governance capabilities. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement WTCO’s data management strategy, aligning it with organizational objectives and national standards, including a comprehensive governance framework. Monitor the entire data lifecycle, from creation and storage to processing and disposal, to ensure effective data management that supports operations and decision-making. Establish and enforce data classification systems to protect sensitive data and facilitate secure sharing within the organization and with external entities. Ensure compliance with applicable data protection regulations, safeguarding personal data throughout its collection, storage, and use. Ensure WTCO’s adherence to national and international data regulations, standards, and policies, collaborating closely with the National Data Management Office. Actively collaborate with the National Data Management Office on strategy, policy development, and compliance to align WTCO’s data management practices. Monitor WTCO’s open data initiatives and manage public information access requests in compliance with approved laws and policies. Enhance the maturity and capabilities of the Data Management Office to drive continuous improvement in data governance and management. Report regularly on the efficiency and compliance of data management activities, ensuring transparency and recommending improvements. Participate in periodic data management and personal data protection meetings scheduled by the National Data Management Office. Ensure work is performed according to approved policies, processes, procedures, and instructions. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, practices, cost optimization, and productivity. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and standards within WTCO and related functions (*, HC, HSSE, Risk, Cybersecurity). Escalate problems to ensure efficient and timely resolution of cases/issues. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in data management or a related field. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on critical water transmission infrastructure. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

2e758cf8b9c4b17d.description: About the Role MIMCO Arabia is seeking a Construction Project Manager to lead a large-scale palace construction project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position where the Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the project from mobilization through to handover, reporting directly to the Project Director. Project Context As the main contractor for this significant project, MIMCO Arabia requires a Project Manager with 5-10 years of relevant experience to ensure successful execution. The role involves comprehensive management of project elements within a high-profile construction environment in Riyadh. Key Responsibilities Manage the full project scope, schedule, cost, and quality. Prepare and update the project program, budget, and cash flow. Coordinate effectively with the client, consultant, subcontractors, and suppliers. Lead the on-site team, including engineers, foremen, and document control personnel. Control variations, claims, and change orders throughout the project lifecycle. Enforce Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and quality requirements on site. Conduct weekly progress meetings and issue comprehensive monthly reports. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Management. At least 10 years of experience in construction, with a minimum of 5 years in a Project Manager role. Prior experience in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Strong knowledge of Primavera P6, MS Project, and FIDIC contracts. PMP certification is preferred. Experience on high-end or luxury building projects is considered an advantage. Valid Saudi iqama is required. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves leading a dedicated site team on a significant construction project. The role requires strong leadership and coordination skills within a dynamic project environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Construction Project Manager position with MIMCO Arabia.

2ebb5f110a45080f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كيمياء الزيت الصناعية عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري الشامل، والمساهمة في تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للقسم أو الإدارة، وضمان سير العمليات بفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، واقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيقها. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة في الفرع أو الإدارة، مع ضمان نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطوير أدائهم. تنفيذ العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية المختلفة لتلبية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المتنوعة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل الأخصائي الإداري بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة كيمياء الزيت الصناعية في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويكون جزءًا من بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تطوير الكفاءات وتبادل المعرفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

2ef291ec6522f205.description: Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Group, is seeking a skilled Quality Document Controller to join our team in the Oil & Energy industry. As an independent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, Eram Talent is dedicated to providing outstanding recruitment solutions that satisfy the needs of our clients. With a global reach and network, we specialize in attracting high-potential professionals with sophisticated skills from various industries, including Oil & Gas, Petroleum, Infrastructure, Energy, Water, Transportation, Science & Technology, and Health Care. As a Quality Document Controller, to represent the Client in managing and controlling project documents, correspondence, records, and submissions, ensuring that accurate and current information is properly received, reviewed, distributed, stored, and available throughout the housing renovation project. Coordinate document workflows between the Client, PMC, designers, contractors, operations team, and other stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, or a related discipline. Document-control or records-management experiences certification is preferred. Relevant training in electronic document-management systems is an advantage. Minimum 7 years of document-control experience in construction or engineering projects. Previous experience with a Client organization, PMC, or engineering consultant is preferred. Experience in housing renovation, refurbishment, or building projects is an advantage. Experience with technical submittals, correspondence, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, and project handover documentation. Experience using document-management platforms such as Aconex, Procore, SharePoint, or similar systems.

2e0193557a8ddb26.job_title: Restaurant Receptionist – Premium Neighbourhood Concept (Al Khobar)
2e0193557a8ddb26.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Front of House (Reporting to the Restaurant Manager) Compensation: 6,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this concept is looking for a polished Receptionist to act as the ultimate gatekeeper of the guest experience. The Role As the first point of contact, you are the face of the restaurant. You will manage reservations, warmly welcome and farewell guests, and ensure the flow of the dining room feels effortless from the moment the doors open. By seamlessly optimizing the seating plan, you will play a direct role in the restaurant's daily performance and atmosphere. Your Profile & Experience Experience: No prior experience is required—your personality, warmth, and natural charm matter most. Familiarity with hospitality reservation systems is a plus. Traits: Elegant, poised, and highly organized. You maintain composure and balance even when the room is full and the pace is fast. Language: English fluency (written and spoken) is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Arabic or French are a genuine advantage. Core Responsibilities Reservation Flow: Manage the waitlist, bookings, walk-ins, and seating arrangements with ease, ensuring every guest feels expected and the room's momentum stays consistent. Proactive Communication: Deliver warm in-person interactions and clear, professional phone etiquette. You anticipate needs naturally, such as taking initial drink orders while guiding guests to their tables. Organization & Profiling: Keep the guest list accurate, actively build detailed guest profiles, and maintain an immaculate reception area at all times.

2ecfc23f5052a6ae.description: Company Description AL MASHFA is a healthcare organization committed to delivering high-quality medical services and patient-centered care in Jeddah. The facility focuses on modern clinical practices, safety standards, and collaboration across specialties to improve health outcomes. Team members work in a professional environment with access to advanced medical technologies and opportunities for continuous learning. The organization values ethical practice, respect, and inclusivity for patients and staff alike. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Radiologist role based in Jeddah. The Radiologist will perform and interpret a variety of imaging studies, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and mammography, in accordance with clinical protocols and safety standards. Responsibilities include providing accurate diagnostic reports, consulting with referring physicians on imaging findings, and contributing to multidisciplinary case discussions. The role also involves supervising or guiding imaging technicians as needed, ensuring adherence to radiation safety regulations, and participating in quality assurance and continuous improvement activities. The Radiologist is expected to maintain up-to-date knowledge in radiology and nuclear medicine practices and support patient education by explaining procedures and findings in a clear, compassionate manner. Qualifications Strong foundation in clinical Medicine with the ability to integrate imaging findings into overall patient care. Proficiency in Radiology and Medical Imaging, including interpretation of X-ray, CT, MRI, and ultrasound examinations. Experience or training in Nuclear Medicine for diagnostic and, where applicable, therapeutic procedures. Competence in Mammography, including screening and diagnostic imaging, with adherence to relevant guidelines and safety standards. Recognized medical degree, completed residency in Radiology, and valid license/registration to practice as a Radiologist as per local regulations. Attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and ability to produce clear, concise reports. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical teams. Commitment to continuous professional development and familiarity with current evidence-based practices in radiology.

2e2f58b5b580d416.job_title: Senior Cloud Security Architect Mandiant Cloud and Infrastructure
2e2f58b5b580d416.description: About the Role Google is seeking a Senior Cloud Security Architect for the Mandiant Cloud and Infrastructure team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves partnering with organizations to navigate complex security transformations, particularly those transitioning critical workloads to cloud environments or managing fragmented multi-cloud infrastructures. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Context As part of Mandiant’s Security Transformation Services (STS) team, the Senior Cloud Security Architect will operate directly on the frontlines of major enterprise cloud transformations. This involves working with clients who are either migrating from on-premises environments to cloud or dealing with inconsistent security controls, governance, and visibility across multi-cloud setups. The architect will serve as a technical advisor, translating threat realities into architectural blueprints, operating models, and roadmaps for both engineering teams and executive management. Key Responsibilities Serve as the technical authority guiding clients through migrations from legacy on-premises datacenters to modern cloud environments. Rationalize and elevate sprawling, fragmented multi-cloud footprints, ensuring consistent security. Redesign cloud security architectures and modernize operational workflows, including SecOps, DevSecOps, identity governance, and CI/CD pipeline security. Enforce resilient security baselines aligned with Mandiant frontline threat intelligence. Bridge communication gaps between technical practitioners and senior management, educating client executives and business leaders on security transformation needs. Assist client teams in implementing pragmatic defensive controls such as Zero Trust access models, workload identity federation, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) guardrails, container/Kubernetes security, and cloud network micro-segmentation. Translate root causes from active breach investigations into long-term architectural uplifts and measurable mitigation programs. Produce actionable architectural blueprints, operating model frameworks, and executive-ready roadmaps. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in cloud security architecture. Experience operating directly on the frontlines of major enterprise cloud transformations is required. Demonstrated understanding of the challenges associated with cloud adoption. Company Overview Mandiant, part of Google Cloud, is recognized for its leadership in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence, and incident response services. 2e13beae3d584f01.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تمم الفريق عن مطور برامج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تطوير أكواد برمجية عالية الجودة والمعقدة باستخدام لغة Java وإطارات العمل الحديثة مثل Spring Boot. يركز الدور على قيادة وتصميم معمارية البرمجيات والخدمات المصغرة لضمان كفاءة أداء الأنظمة وسرعة استجابتها وقابليتها للتوسع، بالإضافة إلى توجيه ومراجعة أكواد أعضاء الفريق الأقل خبرة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم وتطوير حلول برمجية معقدة باستخدام Java وإطار العمل Spring Boot. إعداد وتطوير معمارية الخدمات المصغرة (Microservices Architecture) وواجهات برمجة التطبيقات (RESTful / SOAP APIs). المشاركة في اتخاذ القرارات التقنية المتعلقة بمعمارية الأنظمة وقواعد البيانات. كتابة أكواد برمجية نظيفة، آمنة، وقابلة للصيانة والتوسع (Clean Code & Solid Principles). إجراء مراجعة الأكواد البرمجية (Code Reviews) للتحقق من التزام الفريق بالمعايير المعتمدة. أتمتة كتابة اختبارات الوحدة والتكامل (Unit & Integration Testing) باستخدام JUnit / TestNG. القيادة والتوجيه تقديم الدعم الفني والتوجيه للمطورين المبتدئين ومتوسطي الخبرة في الفريق. تحويل المتطلبات الوظيفية المقدمة من محللي الأعمال إلى حلول تقنية وقابلة للتنفيذ. المشاركة الفعالة في تحديد المعايير البرمجية وأفضل الممارسات المتبعة داخل الإدارة. الأداء والأمان تحليل وتحسين أداء التطبيقات واستعلامات قواعد البيانات (Performance Tuning & Optimization). معالجة الأخطاء والثغرات البرمجية وتطبيق أفضل ممارسات الأمن البرمجي. التعاون والتكامل التعاون مع فرق الـ DevOps لتحديث وتطوير خطوط النشر المستمر (CI/CD). العمل وفق منهجيات التطوير المرنة (Agile / Scrum). التعاون الوثيق مع فرق الأمن السيبراني لضمان أمان البرمجيات وسلاسة عمليات النشر والاختبار التلقائي. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في تطوير البرمجيات، مع التركيز على لغة Java وإطارات العمل ذات الصلة. يجب أن يمتلك المرشح القدرة على تصميم وتطوير حلول برمجية معقدة، بالإضافة إلى مهارات قوية في مراجعة الأكواد وتوجيه أعضاء الفريق. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض.

2e6897fa400048e7.description: Not just a job, but a career Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries. Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect. About The Team Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Method Development & Analytical Validation Analyze complex customer process stream compositions (e.g., natural gas, NGL, LNG, refining cuts, petrochemical matrices) to design custom chromatographic separation methods. Define optimum column stationary phase chemistries, film thicknesses, particle sizes, internal diameters, and column length combinations for target separations. Calculate and optimize physical property calculations (e.g., Calorific Value/BTU, Density, Compressibility, Boiling Point Distributions) within GC software scripts. Prepare calibration standards, run repeatability and drift studies, and establish Method Detection Limits (MDL) and quantification limits for trace component analyses (e.g., trace sulfur, oxygenates, moisture). Column Chemistry & Preparation Oversight Establish technical recipes and quality control standards for column packing (packed columns) and phase coating/deactivation (capillary columns). Work directly with Lab Technicians to audit column preparation workflows, evaluate baseline bleed profiles, and troubleshoot column batch variations. Conduct root-cause analysis on column degradation, stationary phase stripping, and matrix contamination issues encountered during system testing. Engineering & Application Support Collaborate with Proposal Engineers during the bidding phase to evaluate challenging stream compositions and confirm theoretical feasibility (cycle time , Detection limits, Peak resolution, etc). Provide specialized analytical support to Tuning Engineers during Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) when handling difficult matrices, non-linear detector responses, or co-eluting peaks. Prepare standard application notes, calibration protocols, chemical safety datasheets (SDS), and analytical technical guides. Qualification And Experience Education: Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related physical science. Experience: 4–7 years of professional experience in chromatography method development, or application engineering—with specific exposure to gas chromatography (GC). Competencies Analytical Problem-Solving: Systematic, scientific approach to resolving complex separation issues, peak co-elutions, baseline drift, and matrix interference. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operations and maintenance, optimizing resource utilization, and achieving production and performance targets. The General Manager will be accountable for the plant’s operational, financial, contractual, people, HSE, and stakeholder performance, while ensuring compliance with company standards and contractual obligations to maximize plant availability, reliability, and revenue. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the plant strategy, operational plans, and performance objectives in alignment with the company’s O&M strategy, providing regular updates and performance reports to senior management and the Board. Lead and oversee plant operations and maintenance activities, including production planning, plant availability, operational efficiency, technical performance, and resolution of operational issues. Manage the plant’s operating budget and financial performance, ensuring effective cost control, productivity, profitability, resource utilization, and compliance with project financial and contractual obligations. Lead workforce planning and people management, encompassing performance management, recruitment, talent development, coaching, succession planning, and maintaining a competent and motivated plant organization. Ensure compliance with all Project Company and contractual obligations, and maintain effective relationships with the Project Company, shareholders, OEMs, contractors, vendors, authorities, auditors, and other key stakeholders. Oversee technical investigations, root cause analysis, risk areas, major and minor plant changes, contractor activities, inventory, procurement, spare parts, services, and resources to maintain plant reliability and operational continuity. Ensure effective implementation and compliance of SAP processes, Integrated Management System (IMS), HSE requirements, policies, procedures, controls, and applicable standards, including audit readiness and corrective actions. Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and technological advancements while ensuring accurate and timely plant, performance, financial, contractual, and progress reporting. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in plant management or a similar leadership role. Demonstrated ability to lead complex operations and manage diverse teams effectively. Strong understanding of operational, financial, and contractual aspects within a plant environment. Work Conditions The role requires a willingness to work in a plant environment and be available outside normal working hours, including during operational emergencies and critical plant activities. Location This position is based in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this leadership opportunity at Acwa.

2efb8fb74ff7274c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برو فاست عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها بفعالية. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمبادئ وعمليات إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على الإشراف على فرق العمل وتوجيهها نحو تحقيق الأهداف. المسؤوليات الإدارية يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع مسؤولية وضع وتتبع موازنات المشاريع، والإجراءات التعاقدية، وتحديد التكاليف ومصادر التمويل، ومتابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة دوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة برو فاست. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

2e2b50d0e3680e85.description: Job Title Project Manager Job Summary Leading and directing the company's strategic real estate project portfolio, and establishing and activating the Project Management Office (PMO) in accordance with the latest global methodologies. The role is responsible for the overall balancing of the portfolio between risks and returns, implementing unified financial and engineering control, and achieving full compliance with all legislative requirements and government entities in the Kingdom, ensuring the protection of the company's financial interests and the achievement of its investment vision. Key Responsibilities - Establishing and activating the Project Management Office (PMO) and applying PMI/Prince2 methodologies across all projects. - Leading the real estate project portfolio: Managing the balance between projects in terms of geographical distribution, product type, timeline phase, risk, and return. - Centralized financial control over the portfolio: Monitoring budgets, processing payment certificates, and reallocating cash liquidity. - Portfolio risk management: Aggregating risk registers from each project, identifying common risks, and developing centralized contingency plans. - Overseeing the full project lifecycle: From investment opportunity and acquisition, through design, contracting, and execution, up to delivery, closing, facilities management, and supervising quality implementation at all stages. - Representing the developer: Ensuring that all project managers under their leadership operate under a unified framework and standardized policies. - Managing major disputes with contractors and consultants and negotiating directly to protect the company's interests. - Preparing portfolio performance reports for the CEO and Board of Directors (Portfolio Dashboard). - Evaluating and developing project managers and building a second line of leadership. - Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, the Real Estate General Authority, Civil Defense, Municipalities, etc. - Monitoring real estate market and contracting sector updates in the Kingdom, analyzing variables, and identifying opportunities and challenges affecting the project portfolio. - Supervising and constantly traveling to company projects across various cities in Saudi Arabia. Minimum Role Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering; Master's degree in Project Management or Real Estate Development is preferred. - Minimum of 15 years of experience in managing real estate development and contracting projects, including 5 years in a leadership role. - Experience in project portfolio management, as well as establishing and activating a PMO. - Proficiency in PMP (mandatory); RMP, ISO, BIM, FIDIC + are preferred. - Proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, Advanced Excel, Power BI, AutoCAD, Revit, and BIM. - Deep understanding of real estate financial modeling (NPV, IRR, Payback). - Knowledge and familiarity with the Saudi Building Code and relevant project management regulations. - Arabic: Native language | English: Excellent level.

2e9463525a778905.description: We are looking for a Security & Loss Prevention Executive (SLP) to support daily security operations across stores and distribution centers. The role focuses on preventing loss, ensuring compliance, and maintaining a safe environment. Responsibilities: Monitor stores and DCs through patrols and CCTV. Detect and prevent theft, violations, and safety risks. Ensure all security systems (cameras, alarms) are working properly. Respond to incidents (theft, accidents, violations). Prepare daily logs and incident reports. Preserve evidence and support investigations. Conduct compliance checks and routine inspections. Maintain records of audits and security activities. 2e0a81b413eaa26d.description: About Bouygues Travaux Publics Bouygues Travaux Publics specializes in civil engineering and engineering structures, holding a leadership position in land use planning and sustainable infrastructure construction globally. The company is committed to diversity and open to all talents. Job Summary Bouygues Travaux Publics is seeking an experienced Security Director to lead the security function for a high-profile signature project in Al Ula, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overall responsibility for strategic security management, physical and operational security, crisis and emergency response, personnel and asset protection, and security intelligence within a complex and strategically important environment. The Security Director will act as the principal security advisor to senior management and project leadership, ensuring a robust, scalable, and intelligence-led security strategy aligned with regulatory requirements, security standards, and company policies. The role requires extensive experience operating in complex, international, and geopolitically sensitive environments. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive and scalable security plan tailored to project-specific threats and vulnerabilities. Conduct continuous security risk and threat assessments, including geopolitical trends, local political dynamics, and potential for civil unrest. Establish and maintain an intelligence network with local authorities, law enforcement, government partners, and security contacts for timely information. Advise senior management and project leadership on security posture, emerging threats, mitigation measures, and strategic priorities. Lead the project's security function, ensuring security personnel are trained, equipped, certified, and operate according to protocols. Manage physical security across the construction site and facilities, including access control, perimeter security, surveillance, and personnel deployment. Develop and enforce security policies and procedures for all project personnel, including site-specific requirements and emergency response. Oversee and coordinate secure movement of personnel, materials, and equipment, including secure logistics and convoy operations. Collaborate with security partners to develop integrated security protocols and coordinate joint operations. Establish and oversee perimeter monitoring and access-control protocols. Develop, maintain, and regularly review comprehensive crisis management and emergency response plans. Lead the on-site crisis management team and coordinate with regional and corporate leadership during incidents. Conduct regular emergency drills and training exercises. Establish and maintain an effective emergency communications framework. Implement and manage security programs for expatriate and local employees, including personal security assessments and protective measures. Ensure sensitive data, intellectual property, and critical project information are protected through access controls and security protocols. Oversee background checks and vetting for employees and contractors requiring site access. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in security leadership roles. Demonstrated experience operating in complex, international, and geopolitically sensitive environments. Ability to establish and maintain trusted relationships with local authorities, law enforcement, government partners, and key security stakeholders. Strong understanding of strategic security management, physical and operational security, crisis management, and intelligence. Work Environment This role is based in Al Ula, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, within a high-profile signature project. The environment involves a complex stakeholder landscape, including project leadership, construction and operational teams, corporate stakeholders, government authorities, law enforcement agencies, and specialist security partners. The successful candidate will need to establish effective relationships across these organizations while maintaining clear ownership of the project's overall security posture. This position requires an individual capable of operating at both strategic and operational levels. Application Process Further details about the project will be shared with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage of the recruitment process.

2e654679ed532fdf.description: About the Role Libera Consultants is seeking an experienced HSE Manager to lead corporate Health, Safety & Environment operations. Role Overview The HSE Manager will oversee corporate HSE operations, safety governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management. The role involves managing established HSE management systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards. A key focus is ensuring employee safety across corporate facilities and for engineering teams conducting site visits to industrial and oil & gas facilities throughout Saudi Arabia. Oversee the implementation and continuous improvement of HSE management systems, procedures, and safety protocols. Ensure compliance with ISO 45001 and applicable Saudi occupational health and safety regulations. Manage HSE risk assessments, internal audits, inspections, and corrective actions. Ensure appropriate HSE procedures, PPE requirements, and safety measures are implemented for engineering personnel visiting industrial and Saudi Aramco facilities. Demonstrated experience in leading corporate HSE operations and ensuring compliance with international standards. Proven ability to manage HSE management systems, risk assessments, and internal audits. 2ef65085bfebb7e4.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking a Traffic Management Systems Lead to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 2e8ab28fa7fd1205.description: مهندس أو فني كهرباء وتحكم – تجميع واختبار وتشغيل اللوحات والمجموعات (الرياض) نبذة عن الشركة: شركة اندماج الأعمال للتجارة (BITC) شركة راسخة في الرياض، متخصصة في توريد وتجميع حلول المياه والحريق والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. نقوم بتجميع لوحات الكهرباء والتحكم محلياً بأنواعها للاستخدامات المنزلية والصناعية والزراعية، وتجميع مجموعات رفع الضغط ومجموعات مضخات الحريق، وتشغيلها واختبارها في مواقع العملاء في مختلف مناطق المملكة. نبذة عن الوظيفة: نبحث عن مهندس كهرباء وتحكم ميداني وورشي، يجمع بين تصميم اللوحات وتنفيذها بنفسه واختبارها في المصنع ، وبين تشغيل المجموعات واختبارها واستلامها في الموقع. المطلوب مهندس يجمع ويسلّم لوحات مطابقة للمواصفات وتعمل من أول تشغيل، ويتحمل مسؤولية النتيجة من التصميم حتى تسليم المجموعة للعميل. أنواع اللوحات والأنظمة التي ستعمل عليها: - لوحات التوزيع الرئيسية والفرعية (MDB / SMDB / DB) للاستخدامات المنزلية والتجارية والصناعية - لوحات التحكم في المحركات (MCC) ولوحات تشغيل المضخات: تشغيل مباشر DOL، نجمة-دلتا، بادئ ناعم، ومشغّل سرعة VFD - لوحات مجموعات رفع الضغط (Booster Sets) متعددة المضخات مع تحكم بالضغط والتناوب - لوحات غطاسات الآبار مع حماية المستوى والجهد والتيار - لوحات الري والمشاريع الزراعية - لوحات مجموعات مضخات الحريق: مضخة كهربائية رئيسية، ومضخة ديزل، ومضخة Jockey ومتحكماتها - لوحات التحويل الآلي (ATS) ولوحات التحكم بالمولدات والمحركات - لوحات PLC وواجهات HMI للأنظمة المؤتمتة المهام والمسؤوليات: في التصميم والتجميع: - تصميم لوحات القدرة والتحكم وإعداد المخطط الأحادي ومخططات التوصيل والتوزيع الداخلي وقوائم المواد وحسابات القواطع والكابلات وتيار القصر - إعداد المخططات التنفيذية والمستندات الفنية للاعتماد لدى المقاولين والاستشاريين - اختيار المكونات (القواطع، الكونتاكتورات، VFD، البادئات الناعمة، PLC، الحمايات، الكابلات) بما يحقق الجودة والتكلفة المناسبة - تجميع اللوحات وتمديد الأسلاك وتوسيمها في الورشة، ومساعدة فريق الفنيين ومتابعة جودة التنفيذ ومطابقته للمخططات في الاختبار: - تنفيذ اختبارات الورشة قبل التسليم (FAT): الفحص البصري، الاستمرارية، مقاومة العزل، اختبار الجهد العالي، واختبار التشغيل الوظيفي الكامل - إصدار تقارير الاختبار وشهادات الفحص وربطها بملف كل لوحة في التشغيل بالموقع: - تركيب وتشغيل مجموعات الضخ والحريق ولوحاتها في مواقع العملاء - ضبط الحمايات وبارامترات VFD والبادئات وحساسات الضغط، وتأكيد اتجاه الدوران وقراءات التيار - 2ee11d207d761822.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 You will lead a team of Renewal Specialists on site and run the team's daily work. You will work closely with the Renewals Manager. You will be the main on-site point of contact for the team. You are responsible for making sure the team hits its retention, churn, and ARR targets. What Will You Do❓ Team leadership and daily operations Lead, coach, and support a team of Renewal Specialists on site every day. Plan daily and weekly work: portfolio coverage, call plans, and follow-ups. Run daily stand-ups and monthly 1:1s with team members. Make sure the team follows renewal processes, playbooks, and quality standards. Handle team attendance, schedules, and coverage during leaves or absences. Performance and targets Own team targets for renewal rate, churn, and ARR retention. Track each specialist's performance and give clear, regular feedback. Spot low performance early and build improvement plans with the Manager. Review call quality, CRM updates, and health-check completion (minimum 4 per customer per year). Escalations and risk Act as the first escalation point for at-risk customers, complaints, and hard renewal cases. Join or lead calls with high-risk or high-value customers when needed. Work with other teams to remove blockers for the team. Make day-to-day decisions within agreed limits, and escalate larger decisions to the Manager. Reporting and communication Prepare weekly and monthly reports on team results, risks, and churn reasons. Keep the Manager updated on team status, issues, and wins through regular syncs. Share customer feedback and churn insights with internal teams. Process and growth Suggest and help roll out improvements to renewal processes and tools. Help onboard and train new team members. Help with hiring, including interviews and assessments. What Are We Looking For❓ 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals. At least 1 year of leading, coaching, or mentoring a team, either formally or as a senior member. Experience with SaaS or subscription-based products. Proven track record of meeting retention, churn, or ARR targets. Strong communication skills (Arabic required; good English required for reporting and working with internal teams). Good with data: comfortable reading dashboards, tracking KPIs, and building simple reports. Who Will Excel❓ Hands-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and Zendesk (or a similar ticketing tool). Experience with customers in the Saudi or GCC market, especially F&B. Experience running a team with a remote or part-time on-site manager. Calm under pressure and able to handle difficult customer conversations. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

2e098ba7877290b8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي مستودعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة عمليات المستودعات، بما في ذلك استلام المواد وتخزينها وصرفها، مع ضمان مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم سجلات وقوائم أصناف المخزون وترميزها وتنظيم سجلات ودفاتر وبطاقات المخازن بما يتوافق مع درجة التجانس والاستخدام. متابعة دقيقة للكميات الداخلة والخارجة من المستودعات ومراقبة المخزون بشكل مستمر. متابعة إصدار أذونات التسليم للفروع والوحدات المعنية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. مطابقة الشحنات الواردة من حيث الكميات والمواصفات مع القوائم المعتمدة، وتحديد أي نواقص أو اختلافات. التأكد من مطابقة المواد المستلمة لشروط التوريد المتفق عليها. إعداد أماكن التخزين وتنظيم المخازن لتيسير عمليات الصرف والاستلام بكفاءة. تطوير إجراءات وأساليب العمل في المستودعات باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة لتحسين الأداء. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمستودعات، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المستودعات أو إدارة المخزون. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة عمليات المستودعات بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يعمل أخصائي المستودعات ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان كفاءة وفعالية عمليات التخزين وإدارة المخزون. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

2e4a482d4edcd2e4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة وتصميم أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على عمليات الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة لهذه الأنظمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معدات وأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والأنظمة، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع. تنفيذ برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بدقة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم شامل لمعدات وأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تصميم الأنظمة وتحديد معايير الأداء. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس ضمن فريق في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بكفاءة وجودة عالية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2e4a8080b4964a46.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة احمد بن عبدالله مسعود للخدمات الصناعية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومتابعة الإجراءات المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية لضمان الامتثال للسياسات الداخلية والأنظمة المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق كافة البيانات مثل الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والمسائل المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق السياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الموظفين والإدارة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات. القدرة على حل المشكلات وتقديم التوصيات الفعالة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل منظمة وداعمة لجميع الموظفين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

2ed020ab5a0bb6a8.description: Data Center Planner oversees activities carried out by 24x7 shift teams for Data Centers as well as responsible for ensuring sufficient personnel is available for each Operations shift. Shall also carry out capacity planning, ensuring new deployments meet the capacity requirements. Is responsible for making sure the racking and associated activities, including any changes, are in compliance with the Data Center standards and Change processes. The work location would be in Thuwwal, Saudi Arabia. Scope of Work Capacity planning for Data Center hosting. Prepare racking diagrams and assign it to relevant shifts. Oversee racking and related activities carried out by the DC Operations team. Manage the shift schedule for the Data Center Operations. Liaise with OSP/ISP Team for the interbuilding connectivity requirements. Plan and recommend Data Center Operational requirements. Vendor Management Manage Data Center Asset Register Oversee break/fix of all Windows/Linux servers throughout the Data Center when hardware failures occur by helping the system owners/proponents troubleshoot issues and sending the appropriate hardware in coordination with the Vendor. Proactive Monitoring and recording of facility security, HVAC, Fire Detection and Suppression Systems, Temperature, Humidity and critical power systems. Ensuring that the Data Center is secure at all times. Ensure all visitors are signed in and escorted at all times while in the Data Centers. Perform other various misc. operational duties as per the SOP approved by the Data Center Lead Compliance with TIA 942 standards for Copper and Fiber cabling across all Data Centers Interface with vendors such as HP, Dell, SUN and Supermicro on the implementation of hardware/systems. APC infrastructure experience is required. Should be able to co-ordinate the day to day activities and preventive maintenance with the facility team and IT staff as per the instructions of the Data Center Lead. Should have good experience with communications circuits and Ethernet cabling (structured copper cabling and fiber optic cables). Proficient in Windows server and Linux configuration and troubleshooting. Proficient in MS Office. Basic knowledge of electrical and mechanical components like Online Double Conversion UPS, Dynamic Rotary UPS, medium/low voltage circuits, and chilled water-cooled HVAC systems.

2e77951e6a93b36d.job_title: Subject Matter Expert - Data Regulations & Licensing-3 Month Contract
2e77951e6a93b36d.description: Mullers Solutions is seeking a highly experienced "Subject Matter Expert (SME)" in data product licensing, certifications, and policy/regulatory frameworks to support a strategic government initiative in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The SME will play a critical role in advising, designing, and developing comprehensive data policies and regulations aligned with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), international data governance standards, and local certification requirements. Key Responsibilities: Develop and refine data product licensing frameworks and operating models. Draft, review, and validate data-related policies and regulatory documents. Align regulatory documentation with PDPL, SAMA, NCA, and other relevant compliance frameworks. Support design of certification roadmaps (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 27701). Conduct stakeholder workshops and provide expert guidance to the client’s policy and data governance teams. Benchmark against regional and global data protection standards. Requirements: 8+ years of experience in data governance, policy advisory, or regulatory consulting. Strong knowledge of Saudi PDPL, international data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA), and certification frameworks. Proven track record of working with or advising government or public-sector entities in KSA or GCC. Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001 LA, or equivalent are highly desirable. Arabic fluency is a plus Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

2eec4c86470524bc.description: About the Company: Segadty is one of the leading brands under Alkaffary Group, currently experiencing significant growth in the digital retail space. As part of the group's broader digital transformation, we operate through platforms like Zid and Salla, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making. In light of this growth, we are expanding our finance team to support the brand’s continued success and ensure strong financial performance and transparency. Role Summary: We are seeking a Senior Accountant to oversee financial operations and support the growing needs of our e-commerce business. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in online accounting systems and who understands the financial workflows of digital retail operations. NOTE : If you have previous experience working with e-commerce platforms, please include a brief summary explaining the reconciliation process between the payment gateway and the e-commerce store you worked with in the COVER LETTER SECTION. Key Responsibilities: Manage daily journal entries, bank reconciliations, and accounts payable/receivable. Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Analyze order profitability and product-level margins based on data from online platforms. Review supplier invoices and e-invoices issued through the online store. Track and validate cost of goods sold (COGS) using inventory data from Zid and Salla. Coordinate with marketing and operations to produce financial performance reports and business insights. Reconcile payment gateway reports (e.g., Tabby, Tamara, credit cards, bank transfers) with accounting records. Ensure alignment between warehouse stock movement and financial reporting. Minimum of 2 years of hands-on accounting experience , preferably within a company that operates an e-commerce store or digital retail business . Prior exposure to online platforms such as Zid , Salla , Shopify , or WooCommerce is highly preferred. Familiarity with accounting systems like Daftra , Odoo , or QuickBooks with proven ability to reconcile online orders , returns , and shipping transactions . Strong understanding of order fulfillment cycles , payment gateways (e.g., Tabby , Tamara , Mada ), and COD accounting treatment . Solid grasp of inventory accounting , COGS tracking , and revenue recognition principles in a digital commerce context. Working knowledge of Saudi e-invoicing (فاتورة) regulations, ZATCA VAT compliance , and dealing with POS systems . Comfortable using task management tools like ClickUp , Asana , or Notion for documenting workflows and reporting. Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to extract actionable financial insights from e-commerce dashboards and ERP integrations . Bonus: Experience with industries such as perfumes , cosmetics , furniture , or carpets is a plus.
